bends.reason: B1 is the front return-flange joggle bend; its section uses the global registration with no local refit. The scan follows the blue formed profile: the joggle S-step at x=0..3 mm, the ~5.5 mm lip and the separate ~3 mm piece at (-12,-4.5) all sit on blue within ~0.5-0.7 mm. The orange not-formed lip (rotated ~30-35 deg up, small piece near y=+3) has no scan points. The lip is parallel to the return flange and offset ~2 mm, so the joggle is formed.

B2 is the other bend of the front joggle (B1/B2 are parallel, ~2-3 mm apart). This plot's local parent refit slid the whole scan profile ~10-11 mm along the return flange (scan wall corner at x~30 vs CAD ~20; small piece at x~-2..-4 vs CAD -12..-15). That is a registration artifact. Within the scan the full formed profile is there: an S-step ~20 mm from the B8 corner, and a lip parallel to the flange (slope within ~1-2 deg) offset ~2 mm toward the ring face. Not-formed would tilt the lip ~35 deg, and that is absent. The globally registered B1 section crosses the same joggle and shows the complete S on the blue profile.

B3 is the back return-flange joggle bend; its section uses the global registration with no refit. The scan's S-step (upper notch and lower dip at x=0..3 mm), its ~5.5 mm lip and its separate small piece at (-12,-4.5) all coincide with the blue formed profile. Nothing lies on the orange lip rotated ~30-35 deg up. The lip is parallel and offset ~2 mm, so the joggle is formed.

B4 is the other bend of the back joggle (paired with B3, parallel, ~2-3 mm apart). This plot's local parent refit slid the scan ~6-7 mm along the return flange (scan corner x~26 vs CAD ~20; the small piece is shifted the same way). That is a registration artifact. The scan shows the formed geometry: an S-step ~20 mm from the B6 corner, and a lip parallel to the flange (slope 0.32 vs 0.34) offset ~2 mm. There is no ~35 deg lip tilt as the orange reference would show. The globally registered B3 section shows the complete S on blue.

B5 is the left-side ~90 deg bend from the wall to the return flange. The scan traces the blue ~11 mm return flange running down-left from the bend at ~90 deg to the ~40 mm wall, and also the wall and the next face. The orange straight continuation (up-left) has no scan points.

The scan follows the blue child: a ~21 mm return flange, the joggle step at (-15,-16), the lip to (-19,-23) and the separate small piece at (-24,-27). It also follows the parent wall and the face beyond it. The orange child (rotated up-left) is empty.

B7 is the right-side ~90 deg bend from the wall to the return flange; its section uses the global registration. The scan lies on the blue ~11 mm return flange running down-left from the bend to (-8,-9.5), and on the wall and face beyond. The orange straight continuation is empty.
